# Psalm 98 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm. Sing to-YHWH a-song new, for wonders he-has-done; has-saved for-him his-right-hand and-arm-of his-holiness.

**2** Has-made-known YHWH his-salvation; before-eyes-of the-nations he-has-revealed his-righteousness.

**3** He-has-remembered his-steadfast-love and-his-faithfulness to-house-of Israel; have-seen all ends-of the-earth the-salvation-of our-God.

**4** Shout to-YHWH all the-earth; break-forth and-sing-for-joy and-sing-praises.

**5** Sing-praises to-YHWH with-the-lyre, with-the-lyre and-voice-of song.

**6** With-trumpets and-sound-of the-horn shout before the-King YHWH.

**7** Let-thunder the-sea and-its-fullness, the-world and-dwellers in-it.

**8** Let-the-rivers clap hands; together let-the-mountains sing-for-joy,

**9** Before YHWH for he-comes to-judge the-earth; he-will-judge the-world in-righteousness, and-peoples in-equity.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **98:1**: 'His-right-hand and-arm-of his-holiness' — divine warrior imagery; God alone achieves salvation (no human agency mentioned).

- **98:8**: 'Rivers clap hands' — creation personified in worship; the rivers themselves participate in cosmic praise.

— EMET
